title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial on 1973-09-26
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Profesional v7.02 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) DSBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) D

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar second set, with “Loser” highlighted as a standout moment.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean board rendering, offering a crisp and listenable listening experience. Fans note that the second set delivers the real excitement of the night—especially the performance of “Loser”—while the first set is considered less essential. Overall the show is viewed as an excellent addition to any Deadhead’s collection.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are highly favorable (4‑5 stars). The show is described as excellent with a strong second set, and the recording is called a very nice board rendering, indicating top‑tier soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly mention a "very nice board rendering" with no complaints about muddiness or dropouts, suggesting a clear and well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The second set is highlighted as the main attraction, while the first set is considered less compelling but does not detract from the overall enjoyment.
